identity_naming_rule.rule: dataset_id, episode_id and camera_id are always non-empty strings; "" is never an identity
identity_naming_rule.metadata_free: use the literal "unknown_metadata" when the sensor/metadata identity is genuinely unknown
identity_naming_rule.single_camera: a known single-camera dataset declares its real camera key (for example "front"), never "" and never "unknown_metadata"
identity_naming_rule.distinguishable: unknown_metadata (no sensor metadata) and a real camera key (known single camera) are different values and stay distinguishable

bayer_cfa.note: real CFA measurement; phase and real sampling coordinates preserved

synthetic_cfa.note: synthetic CFA; same phase/coordinate discipline, always disclosed as synthetic

rawvla_rgb3.note: author HDR-derived / pseudo-RAW; must not fabricate a fourth measurement or CFA phase

input_identity.time_order_rule: the window is always oldest_first; the DBSR fusion entry is newest_first; only the named adapter oldest_first_to_newest_first converts, no implicit flips elsewhere

coordinate_units.spatial_unit: sensor_pixel (integer sample index on the full sensor grid)
coordinate_units.pull_convention: source_xy is the pull coordinate used to sample the historical source from the current reference position; source_xy[i] points into the historical frame
coordinate_units.packed_grid_relation: one packed-cell displacement equals two sensor pixels; each CFA phase has its own offset
coordinate_units.input_channels_multiple_rule: correspondence input_channels must be a whole multiple of the measurement channels: CFA 4/8, rawvla_rgb3 3/6
coordinate_units.forward_backward_check: current and the past two frames only; a future frame is never read
coordinate_units.interpolation_taps: return the actual four taps as SourceKey plus weights; zero padding at borders, no wrap-around
coordinate_units.temporal_unit: integer frame_id within an episode; timestamp carries the metadata time_unit and is not silently rebased
coordinate_units.reference_time: episode-local; no future frame may be read for a causal estimate
coordinate_units.flow_risk_status: proxy until validated against the independent calibration split

data.data_root_scope: remote server path; not present in the local worktree
data.count_rule: npz counts cover only the declared raw_roots; data/<format>/rgb mirrors data/<format>/raw 1:1 and is reported separately, never summed into a frozen count

split_grouping.lighting_variants: same group as the base trajectory
split_grouping.method: metadata first, then the audited source_group; file stem equality is never automatic evidence of same origin
split_grouping.camera_holdout: explicit table; random frame splitting is not a cross-camera holdout

data.split_ratio_status: first candidate ratio; frozen by P0 only after non-empty conditions, scale and source coverage are checked; existing official partitions take precedence
data.manifest_missing_metadata_rule: scene/session/sensor are null in the RawVLA cache metadata (index.known_gaps); null means absent metadata, never 'single camera'; camera_id uses the vocabulary below and camera_ids carries the exact protocol camera names

loader_contract.per_platform_call: one call per platform manifest; loader_split_manifest resolves the manifest's relative_path_base against raw_cache_root
loader_contract.note: the default root derivation (root/data/...) does not match the server layout; each region is requested separately and the instance paths must equal exactly that region of that platform's manifest

model_input_mode.semantics: C=3 pseudo-RAW model input; a fourth measurement or CFA phase is never fabricated
model_input_mode.other_entry: bayer_cfa / synthetic_cfa (C=4) is a different model-input entry and is not in this pool

storage_encoding.layer: per-file cache storage encoding (B manifest row level, field name stays `input_mode`)
storage_encoding.observed_on: 2026-10-14, recomputed from the frozen manifest rows (each pool has exactly one value)
storage_encoding.location: row-level `input_mode` in data.platforms.<platform>.manifest_* and in data.manifest_columns

model_input_mode_vs_storage_encoding.rule: the two names are never interchangeable: model_input_mode is constant for the pool and is a model contract, while row-level input_mode describes how one cache file stores its RAW values

data.manifest_columns_note: row-level `input_mode` is the per-file cache storage encoding (raw_uint8_pseudo_raw / raw_float32_hdr_derived); it is not the model input mode, which is data.platforms.<platform>.model_input_mode
data.region_checks_scope: checks are per platform: the two datasets have independent relative-path namespaces and the loader serves one protocol at a time, so cross-platform path-level dedup would manufacture false identities; disjointness/union are computed inside each platform manifest

seeds.non_overlap_rule: set(model_seeds) & set(data_seeds) must be empty; enforced by TrainingBudgetConfig.validate

data.value_status: confirmed_by_lead_2026-10-14: 沿用仓库既有 +1000 偏移约定，且与 model_seeds 不相交

seeds.old_probe_seed_offsets_status: consumed by the old N01 probes; the new n01-full-v1 namespace does not reuse their streams
seeds.note: distinct streams and disjoint values; one RNG is never shared between data and model roles

unique_source_policy.rule: one RAW sample may be referenced by several candidate domains but counts once in a single estimate
unique_source_policy.independent_observation_count: deduplicated by SourceKey across a single estimate; repeated transmission of one frame is one key
unique_source_policy.priors: listed separately; never added to the independent observation count
unique_source_policy.rejected_source: a support-relation status, never a rewrite of the original sensor state
unique_source_policy.duplicate_control: domain_content must be compared against a same-node duplicate_current control

exact_replay.default_rule: the formal estimate uses 32 unique frames; algorithm comparison may use 8/16/32
exact_replay.older_information: kept only as a sourced summary with declared provenance
exact_replay.retraction_beyond_range: invalidate the contaminated summary and rebuild from the legal boundary; record the history loss

modes.fixed_decision_replay: motion/support decisions frozen; replace the retracted source content, re-encode, recompute fusion weights and readout; the result must not change
modes.counterfactual_replay: remove the source from the input event stream and recompute motion, support, normalisation and all state; only this mode may claim the whole result no longer depends on that source

exact_replay.spatial_retraction_first_version: invalidate by domain support on the source RAW, re-encode the whole affected source and recompute fusion weights (convolution receptive fields crossing domains)
exact_replay.context_sources: any retained neighbourhood context must be declared in context_source_ids and covered by the content-isolation test

content_backbone.non_full_size_rule: ContentConfig.validate refuses a non-full-size dbsr (channels != 64, num_blocks != 9, feature_width != 512) and any readout other than 256x2048; change the backbone field instead of relaxing the contract

readout.note: pass VisualPrefixConfig(in_dim=512, width=2048) or from_readout_config(in_dim=512); the backend default in_dim=readout_width must never be relied on

p2_required_changes: 4/8 channel CFA stems and 3/6 channel pseudo-RAW stems
explicitly disable the ImageNet weight download/load (ResNetFPN init_weight=False and no torchvision branch)
separate depth selection (args.pretrain) from pretrained weight loading

temporal_rules.guarantee_scope: the sequential branch keeps its own conditions; it does not transfer a neural confidence guarantee

models_and_upstream.spatial_rule: local affine predictive compatibility test; the connected graph only proposes candidates

mamba.p0_scope: lock source and dependency availability only

bsrt.p0_scope: lock source and dependency availability only

correspondence.input_channels_multiple_rule: a whole multiple of the measurement channels (CFA 4/8, rawvla_rgb3 3/6)
correspondence.future_frames: never read; forward/backward consistency uses the current and the past two frames

main.known_difference: no history; retained as a stated difference

main.content_rule: fixed-history equal-weight fusion with active residual blocks for capacity
main.known_difference: parameter difference recorded; no idle parameters

main.content_rule: mature DBSR learned fusion over all legal history
shared: motion checkpoint and calibration with N01

main.content_rule: same as B2 plus the P3 standard detector with whole-domain reset
source-level temporal support, full recompute, spatial support off

interventions.N-stale: N-TS with identical weights and decisions but deliberately retained stale dependency; contamination diagnostic only, never averaged into the deployable main group

primary.note: event AUC over the first eight frames

auc_improvement_vs_B2_B3.planned_source: shared contract section 5 first planning gate; frozen by P0/P3 development variance

static_and_current_degradation_max.planned_source: shared contract section 5 first planning gate; frozen by P0/P3 development variance

metrics.negative_result_policy: a failed gate is reported with the completed controls and diagnostics; tests or thresholds are never edited to manufacture a pass

thresholds.policy: any threshold that needs measurement stays pending_calibration until P3 freezes it; the formal matrix must not start with a placeholder

plateau_conditions: at least two effective learning-rate drops
the final low-LR phase has eight consecutive improvements below the locked delta_val
best checkpoint is not pinned to the budget end
small-set fit, input and gradient diagnostics pass
resume_requirements: checkpoint stores model, bridge, backend trainable parameters, optimizer, scheduler, scaler
sampler permutation and cursor are stored
data/calibration/support/source hashes and consumed sample count are stored
resume check verifies the next batch identity, the next loss/update and run continuity, not just a reload forward

platform_rules.same_budget: identical arms, learning-rate search, shared-layer initialisation, data flow and supervision
platform_rules.seed_execution: seeds may run serially; one resource-checked job at a time

gpu.rule: re-measure free memory before each run; count existing services into the budget; never stop other projects' services

torch.remote_runtime: torch 2.7.1+cu128 / Python 3.10.21 (existing StarVLA env, read-only reuse)
torch.rule: the local CPU lock must not overwrite the remote CUDA torch; the GPU environment has its own separate requirements/lock (configs/backends/n01-full-runtime/)

platform_rules.policy_backend: frozen RawVLA PI0/PI05 adapter; no upgrade to a floating latest backend
platform_rules.readout_binding: server-side readout binds loopback; the existing -L tunnel is enough

planning_envelope.source: shared contract section 5 planning candidates, not sufficient-training evidence

profiling_resolution_plan.note: the measured values replace the pending fields; the CPU tiny path only covers numerical tests

pending_profiling.note: the section name is historical; every value below is measured, locked at P0, or a declared estimate

resolution.source: P0 首选起点 128/history=8；机制通路 20k 起、上限 100k（共同契约第 5 节规划候选，非充分训练证据）

step_time_seconds.source: runs/p0-20261014/outputs/profile_dbsr_p0-20261014.json 的 128/8 point，forward_backward.p50_s；entry=encoder、fp32、batch=1、单相机视角、20 次同步迭代、3 次预热；设备 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell、torch 2.9.1+cu128

effective_batch.formula: 实测 micro-batch 1 × 梯度累计 8

max_steps.source: P0 首选起点 128/history=8；机制通路 20k 起、上限 100k（共同契约第 5 节规划候选，非充分训练证据）

gpu_hours.basis: 128/8, microbatch=1, accumulation=8, 7 arms x 3 seeds x 2 platforms, cameras=2/3
gpu_hours.source: Original P0 measurement; corrected matrix and optimizer-update accounting in independent audit

io_mib_per_second.scope: single process, warmed decoded episode cache, 20 real loader samples per split; throughput of returned RAW value tensors, not physical disk bandwidth

historical_30run_cost_estimate.basis: 每次 update = 相机数 × 0.046073 s（LIBERO 2 相机 → 0.09215 s；RoboTwin 3 相机 → 0.13822 s）；30 runs = 3 种子 × 5 方法 × 2 平台

statistics.paired_unit: platform / task_template / source_group, crossed with training seed
statistics.resampling: Within each platform resample task clusters, then source trajectories within tasks; resample training seed as a crossed factor shared across tasks. Reuse identical resampling indices for every arm; never bootstrap frames/cameras as independent units.
statistics.report: effect sizes with the paired uncertainty, censored/unrecovered cases retained in the table
statistics.estimand: In-distribution held-out trajectories within the observed task pool. Task templates are shared across splits; no unseen-task/scene generalization claim.

task_groups.source: All 2403 real NPZ metadata records re-read during independent P0 audit

multi_comparison.order_policy: pre-registered in the order above; the primary comparison is first; Holm is applied over the whole family

token_contract.camera_combination: concatenate tokens at the backend when no accepted cross-camera geometry exists; never merge RAW statistics across cameras

backend_protocol.frozen_default_assets: read-only reuse of the complete Default numbers; new models never write into the frozen output directories
backend_protocol.comparison_policy: P7 compares the frozen backend against the same-range unfrozen variant; P8 is the full closed loop

profiling.local_cpu_policy: refuse with an explicit error; never report a CPU fallback as a GPU profile

encoder_contract.step_output: tensor or a dict/list of tensors (backward uses the sum)

measurements: p50/p95 forward+backward after warm-up with explicit device synchronisation
I/O throughput on the real NPZ read path when --io-root is given

excluded_from_estimate: SEA-RAFT adaptation and support-replay costs not yet executable

cost_model.note: 21 runs per platform = 7 declared arms x 3 seeds; 42 total. Costs include 8 microsteps and per-platform cameras. 300k is an extrapolation, not P4 authorization.

profiling.second_batch_rule: an occasional idle moment on the shared server is not a dedicated GPU; record still-running services and the memory assigned to this task
profiling.backbone_override_rule: non-full-size DBSR profiling is refused; an explicit profiling.backbone / --backbone override selects a different backbone (the P6 BSRT backbone) instead of silently relaxing the full-size contract
profiling.channel_multiple_rule: encoder input_channels must be a whole multiple of the measurement channels (CFA 4/8, rawvla_rgb3 3/6)
profiling.encoder_factory_status: Executable P0 probe of existing DBSR, not N01FullEncoder; four-channel synthetic CFA only. history>8 uses direct backbone/fusion modules.
